name: fixmate-server
description: Backend server for **FixMate**, a home service booking platform built to connect customers with skilled technicians. The Express.js API handles authentication-related operations, user management, service listings, bookings, reviews, and administrative tasks. Built with Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, it provides RESTful APIs for the FixMate frontend with role-based access control for customers, technicians, and admins.
author: Amit Paul
